verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful, OpenAPI-specified /v1 API that gives programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries, with an interactive playground and an API changelog. Workspace members can create their own scoped keys, but only on Business or Enterprise plans. Action items are not a documented first-class API field; the docs only describe extracting them from notes as a use case. Missing for 10: a dedicated action-items endpoint or field, self-serve keys on all plans rather than Business/Enterprise only, a guarantee of complete per-meeting coverage (transcripts can be too large to return inline), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
Any workspace member on a **Business** or **Enterprise** plan can create API keys.
When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.
Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
